tool_args.content:
# Statement of Work: NextGen Patient Portal & Analytics Dashboard

**Client:** Lumina Health (Sarah Jenkins)
**Provider:** Anima
**Budget:** $12,500
**Timeline:** 6 Weeks

## 1. Project Overview
Development of a NextGen Patient Portal and Analytics Dashboard utilizing full-stack AI engineering to improve patient engagement and clinical insight visibility.

## 2. Scope of Work & Deliverables
- **Phase 1: Architecture & Data Pipeline (Weeks 1-2):** Design secure database schema, integrate AI-driven analytics ingestion engine, and set up HIPAA-compliant API endpoints.
- **Phase 2: Core Frontend Development (Weeks 3-4):** Build responsive patient portal UI, real-time analytics graphs, and interactive dashboards.
- **Phase 3: AI Integration & Testing (Weeks 5-6):** Implement predictive diagnostic assistance workflows, end-to-end testing, security auditing, and deployment.

## 3. Payment Schedule
- 50% Upfront Deposit upon SOW signature
- 50% Upon Final Deployment and Handover
